answer: Publish a latency puzzle: each identity solves a 48-bit PoW whose target delay is drawn from a published table keyed by recent answer cadence. A key that fires every epoch must hit a 900ms nectar floor before its quill proof is accepted; farms that reply in under 120ms fail and forfeit that epoch share. Bundle the measured RTT with the answer hash so peers can recheck. After close, publish pass/fail counts per pearl bucket so farms cannot hide behind average latency.
